title: 第015章 拳破护卫如败革第016章 三招卸甲赵统领
lines: 死寂。
长街之上，只有风吹过街面卷起的细微尘土，和那几具尸体伤口处血液滴落的、轻微到几乎听不见的“滴答”声。空气中弥漫的血腥味，混合着肃杀，令人作呕。
高台上，苏远山脸上的狞笑彻底凝固，转为一种极致的错愕和难以置信。苏清雪掩着口，美眸瞪大，指尖冰凉。赵刚脸色煞白，嘴唇哆嗦着。秦烈更是如遭雷击，呆立当场，仿佛看到了世间最荒谬、最恐怖的景象。
一个照面！仅仅一个照面！
一名淬体四重的狼卫，数名淬体二三重的精锐刀斧手，在占据人数、地利、偷袭先机的绝对优势下，被那个他们眼中的“废物”，轻描淡写地……击溃了？！
狼卫被凭空按死，刀斧手武器断裂、自相践踏，而那个灰衣少年，甚至连脚步都未曾真正停下，只是侧了侧身，抬了抬手，便从这绝杀之局中“滑”了出来，甚至还……往前走了一步！
这怎么可能？！
“不……不可能……”秦烈失魂落魄地喃喃自语，仿佛信仰崩塌，“他……他怎么会有这种力量……那种手法……绝不是秦家的武功……”
苏远山猛地回过神来，眼中爆发出比之前更加炽烈、更加疯狂的杀意和……一丝他自己都未察觉的惊悸。秦夜刚才展现出的那种举重若轻、仿佛能洞悉一切破绽的诡异手段，以及那轻飘飘一掌就按死狼卫的恐怖力量，都远远超出了他对“淬体一重”的认知！
“此子……有古怪！”苏远山从牙缝里挤出几个字，声音嘶哑，“绝不能再给他近身的机会！赵刚！让弓弩手……”
他的话还没说完，长街上的秦夜，再次动了。
他没有继续向前，而是微微侧头，目光扫过那些从混乱中挣扎爬起、脸上还残留着惊骇和茫然的刀斧手和剩下的几名狼卫，最后，落在了高台上。
“苏城主，”秦夜的声音依旧平静，却带着一种穿透人心的力量，“你的这些‘网’，似乎不太经用。要不要，再换一批结实点的？”
“狂妄！”苏远山暴怒，彻底撕下了最后一丝冷静的伪装，嘶声吼道，“放箭！给我放箭！射死他！！”
“城主有令！放箭！”
赵刚几乎同时厉声下令。
弓弦震动的闷响汇成一片，刺破了凝固的空气。墙头上，数十支闪烁着幽蓝寒光的箭矢，如同出巢的毒蜂，带着凄厉的破空声，朝着长街中央、那个孤零零的灰色身影，暴射而去！箭矢覆盖了秦夜周身数丈范围，几乎封死了所有闪避的空间！
这是真正的箭雨！淬毒的箭雨！足以将任何淬体境武者射成刺猬！
长街两侧，那些偷窥的百姓发出惊恐的尖叫，许多人彻底闭上了眼睛。
高台上，苏清雪握紧了拳头，指甲深深掐入掌心。秦烈眼中闪过一丝快意，仿佛已经看到秦夜被万箭穿心的惨状。赵刚屏住呼吸，死死盯着箭矢的轨迹。
然而——
面对这足以致命的箭雨，秦夜非但没有后退，反而再次向前踏出了一步！
四十八步！
与此同时，他动了。
不是躲避，而是迎击！
他的双手在身前划出两道玄奥的弧线，动作看起来并不快，却带着一种奇异的韵律。就在第一波箭矢即将临体的瞬间，他双手十指如同穿花蝴蝶般急速弹动！
“叮！叮叮叮！叮叮——！”
一连串清脆密集、如同雨打芭蕉般的声音骤然响起！
只见那些激·射而至的箭矢，竟像是撞上了一层无形的、柔韧的屏障，又仿佛被一只只看不见的手精准地拨动，箭杆纷纷震颤、偏移，擦着秦夜的衣角、发梢飞过，深深扎入他身后的青石板地面，箭尾兀自嗡嗡颤抖，却无一支能触碰到他的身体！
更令人骇然的是，有几支角度刁钻、本该必中的箭矢，在接触到他指尖的刹那，竟如同被赋予了生命般，以更加迅猛的速度，倒射而回！
“噗嗤！噗嗤！”
墙头上，两名弓弩手猝不及防，被自己射出的、倒飞回来的箭矢贯穿了喉咙，瞪大眼睛，带着难以置信的神情，从墙头栽落。
“这……这是什么妖法？！”一个弓弩手失声尖叫，握着弓的手都在发抖。他们从未见过如此诡异的场景！空手接箭？不，是弹开，甚至是……反弹？！
“不是妖法。”高台上，苏清雪俏脸煞白，声音带着一丝不易察觉的颤抖，“是极其高明的真气操控和发力技巧！他将真气遍布周身，形成微弱的力场，以巧劲拨动箭矢轨迹，甚至借力打力！这需要对时机、角度、力量有着恐怖到极致的掌控力！这……这绝不是淬体一重能做到的！他隐藏了实力！至少是淬体四重，甚至……更高！”
“淬体四重以上？！”苏远山心头剧震。一个十七岁、被判定为天生绝脉的废物，怎么可能在短短几天内，拥有淬体四重以上的实力？！这完全颠覆了他的认知！
content_en:
Dead silence.
On the long street, there was only the fine dust blown up by the wind on the street, and the soft and almost inaudible "tick" sound of blood dripping from the wounds of the corpses. The smell of blood in the air, mixed with the chill, was nauseating.
On the high platform, the ferocious smile on Su Yuanshan's face completely froze, turning into a state of extreme astonishment and disbelief. Su Qingxue covered her mouth, her beautiful eyes widened and her fingertips were cold. Zhao Gang's face turned pale and his lips trembled. Qin Lie felt as if he had been struck by lightning and stood frozen on the spot, as if he had seen the most ridiculous and terrifying scene in the world.
A face-to-face meeting! Just a face to face!
A wolf guard of the fourth level of Body Tempering, and several elite swordsmen and axemen of the second and third levels of Body Tempering, with their absolute advantages in numbers, location, and sneak attack opportunities, were easily defeated by the "trash" in their eyes... in an understatement? !
The wolf guard was pinned to death out of thin air, the ax hand's weapons broke and trampled on each other, but the boy in gray didn't even really stop. He just turned sideways, raised his hand, and "slipped" out of this fatal situation, and even... took a step forward!
How is this possible? !
"No...impossible..." Qin Lie muttered to himself in despair, as if his faith had collapsed, "He...how could he have such power...that technique...is definitely not the martial arts of the Qin family..."
Su Yuanshan suddenly came to his senses, his eyes bursting with more intense and crazier killing intent than before and... a trace of panic that he himself was not aware of. The strange method that Qin Ye showed just now with ease and ease, as if he could see through all the flaws, and the terrifying power of killing the wolf guard with just one palm, were far beyond his knowledge of the "First Level of Body Tempering"!
"This kid... is weird!" Su Yuanshan squeezed out a few words through his teeth, his voice hoarse, "We must never give him another chance to get close! Zhao Gang! Let the crossbowmen..."
Before he finished speaking, Qin Ye on the long street moved again.
He did not continue to move forward, but turned his head slightly and glanced at the axemen and the remaining wolf guards who struggled to get up from the chaos, with shock and confusion on their faces, and finally landed on the high platform.
"City Master Su," Qin Ye's voice was still calm, but with a power that penetrated people's hearts, "these 'nets' of yours don't seem to be very durable. Do you want to replace them with a batch of stronger ones?"
"Arrogant!" Su Yuanshan was furious, completely tearing off the last trace of calm disguise, and roared, "Fire the arrow! Shoot the arrow for me! Shoot him to death!!"
"The city lord has an order! Fire arrows!"
Zhao Gang sternly ordered almost at the same time.
“Buzz——!”
The muffled sounds of the vibrating bowstrings merged into one, piercing the solid air. On the top of the wall, dozens of arrows flashing with a cold blue light, like poisonous bees emerging from the nest, shot towards the lonely gray figure in the middle of the long street with a shrill sound of breaking through the air! The arrows covered Qin Ye's body for several feet, sealing off almost all space for dodge!
This is a real rain of arrows! The poisonous arrow rain! It's enough to turn any Body Tempering Realm warrior into a hedgehog!
On both sides of the long street, the peeping people screamed in terror, and many closed their eyes completely.
On the high platform, Su Qingxue clenched her fists and dug her nails into her palms. Qin Lie's eyes flashed with joy, as if he had seen the tragic situation of Qin Ye being pierced by thousands of arrows. Zhao Gang held his breath and stared at the trajectory of the arrow.
However——
Faced with this fatal rain of arrows, Qin Ye not only did not retreat, but instead took a step forward again!
Forty-eight steps!
At the same time, he moved.
Not to avoid, but to attack!
His hands drew two mysterious arcs in front of him. His movements didn't look fast, but they carried a strange rhythm. Just when the first wave of arrows was about to hit his body, the fingers of his hands flicked rapidly like butterflies piercing flowers!
"Ding! Ding-ding-ding! Ding-ding--!"
A series of crisp and dense sounds, like rain hitting banana trees, suddenly sounded!
The arrows that were fired seemed to have hit an invisible and flexible barrier, and seemed to be moved accurately by invisible hands. The arrow shafts trembled and deflected, grazing the corners of Qin Ye's clothes and flying past the ends of his hair, and deeply penetrated into the bluestone floor behind him. The tails of the arrows buzzed and trembled, but none of them could touch his body!
What was even more shocking was that several arrows with tricky angles that were supposed to hit the target were shot backwards at an even faster speed as if they were given life when they came into contact with his fingertips!
"Pfft! Pfft!"
On the top of the wall, two crossbowmen were caught off guard. The arrows they shot and flew back pierced their throats. With eyes wide open and expressions of disbelief, they fell from the top of the wall.
"This... what kind of magic is this?!" A crossbowman screamed, his hand holding the bow trembling. They have never seen such a weird scene! Catching an arrow with nothing? No, it bounces away, or even...rebounds? !
"It's not a magic method." On the high platform, Su Qingxue's pretty face turned pale, and her voice had a subtle tremor, "It's an extremely superb skill in controlling and exerting energy! He spread the energy all over his body, forming a weak force field, and moved the arrow with skillful force. Arrow trajectory, even using force! This requires extremely terrifying control over timing, angle, and strength! This... is definitely not something that can be achieved by the first level of body tempering! He has hidden his strength at the fourth level of body tempering, or even... higher!"
"Body Tempering Level 4 or above?!" Su Yuanshan's heart was shocked. How could a seventeen-year-old waste who was judged to be born with no blood vessels acquire strength above the fourth level of body tempering in just a few days? ! This completely subverted his understanding!
